title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Is Now Streaming With Netflix After New Update
content:
Dragon Ball Super has now returned to action with a new remake series after eight long years, and now the new series is streaming with Netflix after its latest update. There are going to be a lot of major new and returning shows that are going to be competing for all of your attention this month as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , but there’s one that’s likely going to draw lots of attention either way as Dragon Ball Super has kicked off a fully enhanced remake.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an enhanced version of the original Dragon Ball Super TV anime series that made its debut over a decade ago at this point, and the first episode made its debut across other streaming platforms last week . But now with a new update, the premiere episode is now available to stream with Netflix with its new episodes coming to the platform on a weekly basis from here on out. It’s just going to be a bit behind the others.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Premieres With Netflix

The first episode of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is now streaming with Netflix, and it’s going to be about a week behind the anime’s original release in Japan and streaming launches with Hulu and Crunchyroll. The first episode also helps to clear up what kind of project this new series is going to be. Because while there are new scenes and adjustments made to how the original TV series had unfolded, it’s not going to be as “new” as what many fans might have hoped for with the anime’s return.

Because while Dragon Ball Super fans had been hoping for some brand new materials that would line up the canon further ahead of the release of Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol, it turns out that this is not going to be the case. Voice star Koichi Yamadera (who voices Beerus) has confirmed that they have not recorded any new audio for the anime , so its updates aren’t going to include brand new fully voiced scenes. It’s instead going to be the team working with what was already made available. Which likely means that it’s going to be the same case for the English dub if it gets one down the line.

What to Know for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus had been touted by Toei Animation to be an “enhanced” version of the original TV anime series with “extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story.” But with Yamadera already revealing new dubbing has not taken place for at least his character, we’ll have to see whether or not that’s the case for the rest of the remake.

Even if this new Dragon Ball Super anime isn’t as new as fans might hope for, there’s at least some brand new anime now in the works for the future too. Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is a brand new anime adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner Arc from the manga release, and is the first of two arcs yet to get an official anime release. No release date or production staff has been revealed for it thus far, but it’s certainly an exciting thing to keep an eye out for.

How have you been liking Dragon Ball Super’ s new remake anime so far? What are you hoping to see before it ends? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Surprise Isekai Confirms Season 2 Return After 4 Years – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
A surprise Isekai anime series you can now find streaming with Crunchyroll has confirmed it’s coming back for a second season after four years, and the first trailer is showing off the first look at what to expect. The year has been pretty strong for Isekai as fans have gotten to see a bunch of cool new shows making their debuts , but also some major franchises returning for new episodes too. But 2027 is already looking strong with a number of Isekai franchises coming back for its own episodes.

The anime adaptation for Miku and Rein Kuwashima’s I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too wrapped up its first season back in 2023, and has now confirmed that Season 2 of the TV series is currently slated to hit screens next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule. To give fans the first look at what’s coming in this new season (including some new faces) you can check out the trailer and poster for Season 2 below.

I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World Season 2 Confirms January 2027 Release

I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too Season 2 will be officially making its debut sometime in January 2027 as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, but has yet to confirm any concrete release date as of the time of this writing. Potential international streaming plans have also yet to be revealed as of this time, but you can catch up with the first season of the anime now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime. You can also find the special extra episode released earlier this Spring too.

I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too actually returned for a surprise extra episode earlier this Spring , and it was here that the second season was first confirmed to be in the works. This extra episode will likely serve as a bridge in between the events of the first and second seasons, so you’re going to want to be sure to check it out as it’s dropping some hints about where the anime is going to go from here on out when it returns next year.

What to Know for I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World Season 2

I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too Season 2 will see Shin Itagaki returning to direct the new episodes with Millepensee and UNLIMITED PRODUCER by TMS. Other returning production staff members include Hiromi Kimura providing the characters designs, Akiyuki Tateyama and SHIKI composing the music, and Haruka Nunokawa serving as editor. New additions to the voice cast seen in this first look are Ikumi Hasegawa as Iris Knowblade and Sora Amamiya as Mai Kagurazaka.

They’ll be joining the returning voice cast of Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Yuya Tenjo, Akari Kito as Kaori Hojo, Kaori Maeda as Lexia von Arcelia, Ai Kakuma as Luna, Rina Hidaka as Yuti, Marina Inoue as Kuro, and more. Make sure to catch up with everything that’s happened so far just in case. What are you hoping to see in I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too Season 2? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 5 Years Later, Black Clover English Dub Returns for Season 2 Release
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has been airing new episodes of the TV anime this Fall, but now fans of the English dub release can finally kick off its return after five long years of waiting for new episodes. Black Clover is only one of the major franchises returning for new episodes this Fall , but it’s been one of the most anticipated given that fans have been waiting for the anime to return for five long years after a major cliffhanger. Now the wait is over for everyone.

Black Clover Season 2 kicked off its Japanese language broadcast earlier this month as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, but thankfully the anime has also now kicked off its English dub release as part of Crunchyroll’s packed schedule for the Fall . The English dub features a returning voice cast as seen with the first season way back when, and the premiere episode is now available to stream with the platform as English dub fans can finally see the anime’s return.

Black Clover Season 2 English Dub Premieres With Crunchyroll

Directed by Jason Lord, the English dub voice cast for Black Clover Season 2 is headling by returning stars such as Dallas Reid as Asta, Micah Solusod as Yuno, Bryce Papenbrook as Liebe, Max Mittelman as Nacht, T.J. Anthony as Albert, Colleen Clinkenbeard as Charlotte, Patrick Seitz as Dante, Jad Saxton as Dorothy, J. Michael Tatum as Fuegoleon and more with Tom Aglio joining the cast as the voice of Morgen Faust for the occasion too. There’s currently only one episode available, but they’ll be releasing on a weekly basis with Crunchyroll .

The Japanese audio broadcast of Black Clover Season 2 is currently only three episodes into its run, so thankfully fans of the dub aren’t going to be too far behind from the original release. This new season has yet to reveal how many episodes it’s going to be sticking around for, but it’s not likely to be as long as the nearly 200 episode long first season . Especially with the fact that this new season has been jam packed with a ton of fights that are progressing relatively quickly.

What’s Going on in Black Clover Season 2?

Black Clover Season 2 is now adapting the Spade Kingdom Raid arc from Yuki Tabata’s original manga release. This serves as the penultimate arc of the manga series, and there really isn’t much left before the anime reaches its own grand finale. Black Clover ended its manga run earlier this year after 11 years of serialization , and it outlines several major battles that are coming for Asta’s future in the episodes to come. It’s just an all-out war from this point as the Dark Triad are the least of everyone’s worries.

Black Clover Season 2’s first few episodes have felt like they have been speeding through at a quick pace, but that’s just how the manga was for the arc. There are a ton of fights, but the chapters themselves were pretty short in how it was all brought together. The anime isn’t speeding through (and is in fact extending a few moments to give them more weight), it’s just a fast arc of intense fights overall.

How are you feeling about Black Clover Season 2 so far? Are you going to check out the English dub release? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Apothecary Diaries Movie Expands Cast With New Trailers – Watch
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is now in the works on its very first feature film outing, and some new teaser trailers are showing off more of the new additions to the expanding cast of characters. The Apothecary Diaries is currently in the midst of a new takeover this Fall with the third season of the TV anime now airing new episodes , but that’s far from all that’s going to be on offer. The franchise is also hitting the big screen with its first movie in Japan this December, and we’re steadily seeing more and more.

The Apothecary Diaries will first be hitting theaters across Japan later this December with its first feature film , and it’s going to be a brand new story from the original creator themselves. This new story sees Jinshi and Maomao heading to a whole new region, and as a result they’ll be meeting a new cast of characters at the center of the movie’s big mystery. You can check out the two new teaser trailers revealing more of The Apothecary Diaries movie cast below.

When Does The Apothecary Diaries Movie Come Out?

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure will be hitting theaters across Japan on December 11th, but thankfully has already revealed it’s going to have an international launch too. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have confirmed that they will be releasing the new movie across theaters in North America and other international territories (excluding Asia) at a later date, but no concrete release date or window has been announced as of this time. So fans worried they’ll miss out on the movie won’t have to wait too long to check it out.

The new voices joining the cast of The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure include the likes of Kensho Ono as Sujia, Ryota Takeuchi as Eisho, Jiro Saito as Kaja, and they can be seen in the teaser trailer above (along with another character that has yet to be fully revealed as of this time). Other new additions include Ai Mikami as Yinshan and Miyuki Sawashiro as Ruoqing, who is the titular “late lady” who sparks the new film’s journey overall. You can check out their special highlight teaser trailer in the video below.

What to Know for The Apothecary Diaries Movie

These new cast additions join the previously announced new arrivals Mariya Ise as Mu Qing, Nobuo Tobita as Biro , Kumiko Watanabe as Shuu, and Hirofumi Nojima as Bisen. Naturally, Takeo Otsuka and Aoi Yuki will also be returning for The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure as the voices of Jinshi and Maomao respectively. Directed by Norihiro Naganuma for TOHO Animation STUDIO, this new movie is going to feature a brand new story from original novel series creator Natsu Hyuga that has not been seen in the anime releases or manga thus far.

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure sees Maomao and Jinshi heading to a new region in order to fulfill the late wishes of a late concubine , and as a result is sparks a whole new kind of mystery as Maomao discovers that the concubine’s body has been kept in pristine condition despite passing away years before. It’s bound to be a fun new journey, so make sure to check out the original TV anime series now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

How are you feeling about the new The Apothecary Diaries movie so far? What do you want to see go down? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Black Clover Season 2 Reveals Devil Union Asta Character Visual
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released a new Devil Union Asta charactel visual following the premiere of Episode 3 on October 17. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide.

You can see the new visual below.

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: New Bleach Final Season Trailer Reveals First Look at Anime Finale After Hiatus – Watch Now
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is soon officially making its return from a month long hiatus for the anime’s final two episodes ever, and now fans have gotten the first look at what to expect from the grand finale with a slick new trailer. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity hit a surprising snag a month ago when it suddenly announced that the production team would need additional time to work on the final two episodes of the anime. Thankfully, the additional wait will soon be over.

With the final season of the series going on hiatus for the last month to work on the final two episodes, Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity is coming back later this week with the first of these final two episodes . Giving fans the first look at this final battle against Yhwach (which already seems to be expanded from Tite Kubo’s Bleach manga version), you can check out the final trailer for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War below to get ready.

When Do Bleach ‘s Final Episodes Come Out?

As previously confirmed by Viz Media, Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 49 will be making its debut with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ on October 19th at 8:30AMPT, and then it will be followed by Episode 50 releasing on October 26th at 8:30AM PT. This will be the Japanese audio release with English subtitles. I f you are more interested in the English dub release , however, it has also been revealed that the dubbed version of Episode 49 will be debuting on November 23rd at 8:30AM PT followed by Episode 50 on November 30th at 8:30AM PT

Very important new additions to the cast have been revealed ahead of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity ‘s official finale as well. It has been announced that Kazui Kurosaki will be voiced by Azusa Tachibana, and Ichika Abarai will be voiced by Ayaka Ohashi . They’ll be making their official debuts in the epilogue following the fight with Yhwach, but English dub voice cast for these new additions (or their relative screen time in these final episodes) have yet to be confirmed as of this time. It’s just another reason to be excited for what’s next.

How Is Bleach’ s Anime Going to End?

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has made plenty of changes to Kubo’s original manga version of the events through all four seasons of its run thus far, and that’s certainly going to be the case with the finale . The original version of this final fight was relatively short as Kubo was seemingly rushed to his conclusion during the manga’s final weeks with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, but the anime has extended it with Yhwach fully invading all three territories. There are all sorts of characters now in the mix for this fight as a result.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity is going to end with these final two episodes either way, but there’s still more planned for the franchise. Bleach Fes. has been announced as a special event coming to Japan next February to celebrate the anime’s grand finale, so fans are hoping to see some possible news of an anime continuation to come from it. Either way, it’s been a long road for this series that fans will see come to an end.

What are you hoping to see from Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ‘s final two episodes? Can you believe it’s really the end? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: We Are Aliens Film Wins Sitges Film Festival's Anima't Award
content:
Other Japanese films which have won the award are Makoto Shinkai 's your name. in 2016 and Mamoru Hosoda 's Mirai in 2018. However, Kadowaki, who just turned 30 on October 14, is the youngest Japanese director to achieve this feat.

We Are Aliens centers on Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, two boys who as elementary school students became close friends, but jealousy and misunderstandings eventually drove them apart. Years have passed and the two boys have gone in different directions in life. But when the memories from their past come back, they must face what happened between them years ago.

The film stars Ryōta Bandō ( Fureru. , live-action How to Train Your Dragon's Japanese dub ) as Tsubasa, and Amane Okayama ( Blue Giant , live-action I''s , Hirayasumi ) as Gyōtarō, when both characters are young adults. Child actors Yūto Maki and Tasuku Nakagome — who were both selected through auditions — voice Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, respectively, when they were younger. Other cast members include Sakurazaka46 idol group member Ten Yamasaki as Konatsu, comedian Kemuri Matsui as Batahara, Gaku Sano as Tsubasa's friend Seiya Toda, Reika Ōzeki as young Seiya, Arisa Sasaki as Toda's friend Elmo Matsushita, and Edo Harumi as a calligraphy teacher.

We Are Aliens opened in Japan on September 15. The film screened at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival on May 14, and screened in competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, which ran from June 21 to 27. The Melbourne International Film Festival (MIFF), the New Zealand International Film Festival (NZIFF), and the "Japanese Animation Special: Masterpieces of Madness, Exhilarating Prospects 12+1" category of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF) also screened the film. Ottawa International Animation Festival awarded the film the Grand Prize for Animated Feature last month.

Kadowaki, who created the second BEASTARS season's ending sequence and music videos for YOASOBI , served as the film's planner, scriptwriter, director, storyboard artist, and editor. Yaffle — who previously produced music for Fujii Kaze, Kenshi Yonezu , and others — composed the music. NOTHING NEW planned and produced the film, and French studio Miyu Productions ( Ghost Cat Anzu , A New Dawn ) collaborated on the production, after joining on the project in June 2025. Artist adieu performs the film's theme song "Sasakure" (Split).
author: ANN

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, October 5-11
content:
The marathon re-airing of the second season of the live-action A Solitary Gourmet series aired on TV Tokyo on Monday, October 5 at 5:45 p.m., and it earned a 4.5% rating.

The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region. The ratings do not count recordings that viewers watch later.
